instagram.title: Instagram
instagram.subtitle: Connect the professional account Confirm publishes to.
instagram.disconnectBody: Confirm will need a new Instagram connection before it can publish again.
instagram.connectingBody: Complete authorization in the new window. This panel updates automatically; cancel if it stays stuck.
instagram.oauthAborted: Authorization was cancelled or timed out. Please reconnect.
instagram.oauthNotConfigured: Instagram Login isn't configured yet — a platform admin needs to add the Meta app credentials under System → Instance.
instagram.oauthModeUnavailable: The connect flow doesn't match the configured mode — check the OAuth mode under System → Instance.
instagram.oauthNotProfessional: This Instagram account isn't a professional account (Business or Creator). Convert it in Instagram before connecting.
instagram.oauthMissingPublish: Authorized, but posting permission wasn't granted. Reconnect and allow instagram_business_content_publish.
instagram.oauthCsrfMismatch: The connect window didn't match this browser session. Try Connect again.
instagram.oauthRelayTicketExpired: The connect session expired before the relay handed back the result. Try Connect again.
instagram.needsAppTitle: Set up your Meta app first
instagram.needsAppStep1: Create an app at Meta for Developers and add the Instagram use case (API setup with Instagram login).
instagram.needsAppStep2: In the app's Instagram settings, paste the redirect URI below into Valid OAuth Redirect URIs, and add your Instagram professional account to the app.
instagram.needsAppStep3: Enter the Instagram App ID and Secret under System → Instance, then come back and connect.
instagram.needsAppLiveNote: Going Live also needs the two callback URLs above and a Privacy Policy URL (App Settings → Basic). Until the app is Live, only Instagram accounts added to it can connect.
instagram.standardAccessNote: Connecting an Instagram account you own or manage only needs Standard Access — no Meta App Review or Business Verification required.
instagram.needsAppViewerNote: A platform admin needs to add the Meta app credentials under System → Instance first.
instagram.readyCaption: Connects through this instance's own Meta app.
instagram.readyCaptionRelay: Connects via the vendor's hosted relay — tokens transit vendor infrastructure (transit-only, not stored).

storage.title: Storage
storage.subtitle: Preview images stay on local disk until you switch to object storage. Uploads keep working during the move.
storage.copyingLocked: Settings are locked while files copy.
storage.startHint: Local is serving. Object storage is saved — start the copy when you are ready. Uploads will not pause.
storage.startDisabled: Save object storage settings before starting a move.
storage.copyingBody: {{copied}} of {{scanned}} copied · {{size}} · {{orphans}} orphans skipped. The app still reads local files.
storage.readyHint: Copy finished. Local is still serving. You can switch back until you clean local files.
storage.flipBody: Preview will read object storage. Local files stay until you clean them, so you can still switch back.
storage.graceHint: Object storage is live. Local copies remain until you clean them — switch-back stays free until then.
storage.cleanBody: This deletes local copies that already exist on S3. You cannot switch back in one click after this.
storage.doneHint: Local files were removed. Switching back needs a new copy.
